newsitem.title: PERU: March inflation seen at 1.1 pct in Peru - Apoyo.
newsitem.headline: March inflation seen at 1.1 pct in Peru - Apoyo.

text.p: Consumer prices in Peru rose 1.12 percent last month, down slightly from 1.4 percent in the same month last year, private research institute Apoyo SA said.
The official figure was due to be released Tuesday by the National Statistics Institute.

Apoyo said the March rise brought inflation in the first quarter of this year to 2.01 percent, from 4.2 percent in the first quarter of 1996. Apoyo calculated inflation over the past 12 months at 10.11 percent.
It expected inflation in April to slip further to 0.5-0.7 percent.

The figures, if borne out Tuesday, would suggest progress in President Alberto Fujimori's efforts to bring down annual inflation into single digits. Inflation last year stood at 11.8 percent, up from 10.2 percent in 1995, according to official figures.
